channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tristan Thompson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tristan Thompson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Channing Frye, Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Richard Jefferson on thhe group chat dynamics of the 2016 Cavs:

“When we talk about the group chat from the team, there's like six of us, and it's been the same six. There was the full team group chat, then there was the guys that were J.R., Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Channing, and Bron. So that's the group of us. And then we start doing, hey guys, we should get together, do some golf and go do this, and then a conversation kind of got started is, and like, hey, it would be wrong if we didn't invite some of the other guys because it's going to look like, we're calling it this championship. No, it was the group chat from the championship team, not the championship team group chat.”

Richard Jefferson on Channing Frye, Tristan Thompson, Jun 26, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tristan Thompson, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Rick Carlisle:

“My relationship with Tyrese Haliburton… The most compelling moment of that relationship was when he came here and the trade in late January of 22. He was shocked that they traded him. Whenyou travel west to east, you don't get to the east until late in the day because of all the time change stuff. And so we met at a restaurant. It was him, Buddy Hield, I think Tristan Thompson was in the deal as well. And Ty was the last guy to walk in. I went up and I shook hands. I looked him in the eye and I said,”

Rick Carlisle on Tristan Thompson, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 26, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Atkinson had a message to send.

“I don’t regret that one. I had to have Tristan’s back on that blatant foul against him that led to my ejection,”

Kenny Atkinson on Tristan Thompson, Apr 11, 2025. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Raptors head coach Darko Rajakovic on Tristan Thompson’s antics late:

“I think what Tristan did there was no class and disrespectful… I love when my team stands up for themselves.”

Darko Rajakovic on Tristan Thompson, Feb 13, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Moses Malone, Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Andre Drummond:

“My Mount Rushmore of rebounders? Dennis Rodman, Moses Malone, Bill Russell, and Tristan Thompson. Dennis is a no-brainer—his numbers are insane. He once had 26 rebounds and no points in a game. Moses had an incredible knack for tipping the ball in and controlling the boards. Bill Russell’s rebounding numbers were out of this world, even though I’ve only seen clips of him. And Tristan? That’s personal. Battling with him in the paint was always a fight. He’s got a natural feel for rebounding. Those guys inspired me to be the best rebounder I could be.”

Andre Drummond on Dennis Rodman, Bill Russell, Moses Malone, Tristan Thompson, Jan 22, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Julia Poe:DeRozan on Tristan Thompson signing:

“Got the utmost respect for him off the court. Obv. we all know what he brings on the court. I think this would be a great addition for us with what he's able to bring: veteran leadership, understanding what it takes to win a championship.”

DeMar DeRozan on Tristan Thompson, Feb 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @byjuliapoe.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
“Going from being a fan to an opponent and then a teammate, Tristan has always been one of the good guys,”

Larry Nance Jr on Tristan Thompson, Nov 21, 2020. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Rick Noland:Love on Tristan:

“He does so much for this organization. I really hope he's back.”

Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson, Jun 12, 2020. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Love said at Wednesday’s shootaround.

“I would run through a wall for him. He’s the best. Just the type of guy he is, he’s a lifelong friend of mine, so it would be tough to see him go. Obviously I would like to have him around selfishly, but if there’s a better situation out there for him, going to make him happier, have a chance to win a championship, then so be it. I only know Tristan Thompson as a Cavalier and I like it that way.”

Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson, Feb 6, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
“I would always go to war with him. I would run through a wall for him. He’s the best. Just the type of guy he is, he’s a lifelong friend of mine, so it would be tough to see him go. I would like to have him around selfishly, but if there’s a better situation out there for him, going to make him happier, have a chance to win a championship, then so be it. I only know Tristan Thompson as a Cavalier and I like it that way.”

Kevin Love on Tristan Thompson, Feb 5, 2020. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Jay King:Kyrie on rebounding uptick this season:

“I just wasn’t asked to do it a lot in Cleveland. Tristan was like an offensive rebound maniac and Bron was trying to get every rebound. I was with some thirsty guys for rebounding. And that’s OK, that’s their job and I fully support that.”

Kyrie Irving on Tristan Thompson, Mar 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Nick Nurse on Tristan Thompson's resurgence:

“This is a team that gets on the glass, namely that kid from Toronto, Tristan Thompson. He’s playing great. He’s back to his highest level, maybe even exceeding it the way he’s rebounding, scoring running.”

Nick Nurse on Tristan Thompson, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
#CavsTy Lue on everyone having the green light to grab and go:

“We’re going to work with Tristan. He tried to do it today and ran over six people. Outside of that I think everybody else can go. Korver, break it out but give it up at some point. We’ll see how that goes.”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, Oct 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Draymond Green on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Sean Deveney:Draymond Green on Tristan Thompson:

“I ain't gonna meet you at the bus. Summers, you can meet anybody anywhere. But, meet me outside, meet me at the bus -- I ain't gonna give up my money for that.”

Draymond Green on Tristan Thompson, Jun 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @SeanDeveney.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Cavs coach Ty Lue on the impending decison on decipline for Tristan Thompson:

“Haven't heard anything yet, but I know the league will do the right thing.”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, Jun 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @loganmmurdock.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
“Even when Tristan wasn’t playing, he was still there talking to Larry trying to get him through …They have a great relationship, and those two working hand in hand has been good for us.”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, May 23, 2018. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Nance is 25 and Thompson is 27.

“If you watch during timeouts, Tristan is always talking to Larry … I think it’s kind of like a big brother,”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, May 23, 2018. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
“I think Tristan can also get us extra possessions offensive rebounding. He brings toughness and that’s been a problem last couple games. I think he brings toughness, rebounding, defense.”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, Apr 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
More Lue:

“We’ve been playing good basketball right now. We have a good flow and a good rhythm. Tristan understands that, so we’re just going to keep it the same way for right now (and use him off bench).”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, Dec 11, 2017. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Lue said he told Thompson, who started all 78 games he played last season, about his planned lineup shift late last week.

“Tristan has been a big part of what we do. I hated having that conversation, but it was great,”

Tyronn Lue on Tristan Thompson, Oct 3, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Nicholas A. Kovach:LeBron:

“What Dennis (Rodman) did for the Bulls... ON THE FLOOR... Is what Tristan gives our team. He's huge on her glass.”

LeBron James on Tristan Thompson, May 3, 2016. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LeBron James on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Rick Noland:LeBron on Tristan:

“He doesn't need to earn his respect from nobody. People know what he's capable of doing.”

LeBron James on Tristan Thompson, Apr 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: LeBron James on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:LeBron on Tristan:

“Right now it's the elephant in the room ... His value to us is extreme.”

LeBron James on Tristan Thompson, Oct 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: LeBron James on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
James said regarding the Cavs.

“That’s their job, they know how to do it very well and they’ve done that to this point. They’ve brought in and did what they had to do for us to be a contending team. Obviously Tristan is a big part of that run we want to make. I believe that something will happen.”

LeBron James on Tristan Thompson, Oct 4, 2015. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Anderson Varejao on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Even though Thompson missed the first couple of practices this week, the players support him and expect him back in a timely fashion.

“I don't really know what's going on with Tristan right now, numbers and stuff, I'm not sure, but I'm pretty confident that he will be here soon,”

Anderson Varejao on Tristan Thompson, Oct 1, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: David Blatt on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
“For a coach it's every day (wanting Thompson back). I'd rather not think about the bad end of the expectation. I'm just hoping to see him here sooner than later.”

David Blatt on Tristan Thompson, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: David Griffin on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Chris Fedor:#Cavs Griffin on Tristan Thompson:

“Our actions & our offer reflect how excited we are about him. Confident he will be a part going forward”

David Griffin on Tristan Thompson, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: LeBron James on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Chris Fedor:LeBron James on Tristan Thompson:

“I'm very optimistic something will get done, from both sides, long term. Big piece of championship puzzle.”

LeBron James on Tristan Thompson, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: David Blatt on Tristan Thompson
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:David Blatt:

“The obvious question is: ‘Who is the starter, Tristan or Andy?’ And I can tell you, I don’t know.”

David Blatt on Tristan Thompson, Oct 1, 2014. Source: Twitter @mcten.
